research_boundary.observation_contract: 45D proprioceptive policy observation; no height scan or privileged terrain observation
research_boundary.action_contract: existing 12D joint action and deployment-matched action scaling; no online adapter/residual update

terrain_families.name: slope_plus_rough

terrain_families.name: friction_variation

completion_and_termination.complete: robot reaches the registered full-track endpoint, has no safety violation, and remains stable for the registered completion hold; crossing part of the terrain is insufficient
completion_and_termination.fall: environment fall/orientation termination or registered unsafe body state
completion_and_termination.body_contact: any non-foot contact; record separately even when it does not terminate the episode
completion_and_termination.lateral_out_of_bounds: root lateral position exceeds the audited lane boundary minus the registered margin
completion_and_termination.safety_termination: SafetyFilter emergency stop, safety guard termination, or invalid/non-finite action/state
completion_and_termination.timeout: 2000 control steps without completion; report as truncated, never as success
completion_and_termination.threshold_status: exact orientation, contact, lateral margin, and filter thresholds must be copied from the locked deployment safety contract before run

metrics.aggregation: report each cell and each terrain family; do not hide a failed direction or level inside an overall mean

classification_before_results.retain_or_low_share: stable across most registered instances with acceptable motion-quality metrics
classification_before_results.source_candidate: recoverable failures or clear velocity/attitude/slip/filter degradation with safe execution
classification_before_results.not_source_main_domain: frequent unrecoverable failure, near-zero progress, or safety qualification failure
classification_before_results.thresholds: numeric pass/qualification thresholds are intentionally blank until the execution contract is locked; do not infer them from one episode

data_isolation_and_execution_guards.output_directory_policy: new non-overwriting run directory; metrics only; no policy checkpoint

current_implementation_blockers.finding: current geometry protocol exposes only step_height, rough_amplitude, and seed and accepts a single legacy subterrain; it cannot express family, slope direction, stair layout, or spatial friction regions
current_implementation_blockers.impact: cannot execute this manifest through the existing online runner

current_implementation_blockers.finding: continuous rough exists but is single-correlation/noise-band; straight multi-step stairs, slope-plus-rough composition, and spatial friction-region generation are not available as a common scan interface
current_implementation_blockers.impact: new audited generators and geometry tests are required

current_implementation_blockers.finding: legacy rough configuration references pyramid slopes/stairs, while stairs are disabled and pyramid geometry is not the requested straight-line track
current_implementation_blockers.impact: cannot treat those configs as the six-family scan implementation

current_implementation_blockers.finding: existing play/qualification entry points are organized around flat/continuous-rough legacy stages and do not consume this manifest or emit all required metrics
current_implementation_blockers.impact: a manifest-driven frozen evaluator and metric schema are required

current_implementation_blockers.finding: Isaac Lab execution must use the repository AppLauncher/runtime; direct standalone imports are not a valid proof of a runnable simulation
current_implementation_blockers.impact: runtime launch and one-cell smoke test remain prerequisites

implement manifest-driven runner with read-only model loading and full metric logging

notes: This file is a checklist/manifest draft, not a command line and not permission to start simulation.
All numeric difficulty values are candidates from the revised plan. They become training or source limits only after frozen scan, geometry audit, and source qualification.

Because multi-step stairs and slopes are Source families, later stairs/slope tests must be labeled same-family strength/layout extrapolation unless a genuinely different geometry family is registered.
